snippet.title: Razorback Open Beta Trailer
snippet.description:
Request a key for the open Beta at https://discord.gg/eUePpbvPeg

Open contest on Feb21st! Info @Discord

Wishlist on Steam now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3317710/Razorback/

Heavily inspired by Trackmania which I played since its first release, I've been working on this game for two years on my spare time. It will release in June 2025.
